newsitem.title: THAILAND: Bank of Thailand says reference rate 30.062.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Thailand says reference rate 30.062.

text.p: The Bank of Thailand on Thursday said that the weighted average interbank exchange rate was 30.062 per dollar against 29.967 on Wednesday.
The reference rate is the average rate traded the previous day. It has been announced daily by the central bank since the July 2 managed flotation of the baht.
The baht was quoted at 29.95/30.05 to the dollar onshore and 29.85/30.00 in offshore markets early.
